# Case studies (snapshot from Notion, 24 Nov 2026)

Longer write-ups behind some portfolio projects. Use the overview to write or enrich a
case line when the portfolio entry has no Story. Each entry names the portfolio project
it belongs to.

## MEENZ: Product-Led Website Redesign
- Portfolio project: MEENZ
- Platform: WordPress · Type: Website Redesign, Corporate Website
- Figma: https://www.figma.com/proto/UBuML5vtA9Nfn7WLICLVTI/MEENZ-Website?page-id=737%3A9871
- Overview: A product-led redesign and redevelopment of a UK automotive recruitment website, combining clearer candidate and employer journeys with a scalable WordPress CMS, reusable ACF Pro/Gutenberg blocks, automated job listings and a dedicated referral flow.

## PlySupply
- Portfolio project: PlySupply
- Type: Website Redesign, E-commerce
- Overview: Ply Supply needed to transform a standard WooCommerce store into a modern B2B platform where customers can quickly find products, check multi-warehouse availability and request commercial quotes instead of placing orders. We rebuilt the site on WordPress/WooCommerce with deep custom development (30+ Elementor widgets, advanced AJAX filtering, multilingual support), integrated inventory management and an SEO-safe URL migration. The result is a redesigned, scalable product catalog that streamlines quote requests and supports future growth.

## Avetex Furniture: Legacy .NET Store Migration to WooCommerce
- Portfolio project: Avetex Furniture
- Platform: WordPress, WooCommerce · Type: E-commerce, Custom Plugin, Website Redesign
- Timeline: May 2026 to present (final QA and domain switch pending)
- Overview: Migration of a 20-year-old custom .NET furniture store (MSSQL, on-premise server) to WooCommerce on the CozyCorner theme: shared multi-site database mapping, custom server-side import plugin, 7 GB image transfer, URL preservation, options configurator, pricing repair and Stripe authorize-and-capture with Stripe Tax.
- Short version: 4,193 products migrated from a 20-year-old .NET store, 2,400x faster server-side import, 7 GB of images, preserved URLs, configurator kept, Stripe authorize-and-capture with Stripe Tax.

## SAL project
- Portfolio project: SAL ID
- Platform: WordPress · Type: Custom Plugin
- Overview: Secure, role-based authentication, content access and poll management across the site through three custom plugins and an extended child theme with custom post types and taxonomy. lps-authentication integrates with an external API for login, registration and a two-hour session timeout. lps-content-control enforces granular permissions for pages, posts, comments and WPForms surveys. lps-poll-system adds controlled commenting and voting tied to specific roles. Together they give comprehensive access control, detailed logging and a secure, configurable user experience without ongoing admin work.
